title: Count house ad views and click-throughs in GA4
description:
Machines on Machines sends real traffic, but a click on a house ad sends no analytics event, so click-throughs to anth.us and p.apyr.us cannot be counted.

Given a page with a house ad, when half of the ad is on screen, then GA4 receives view_promotion once with promotion_id, promotion_name, creative_name and location_id.
Given a house ad, when a reader clicks or middle-clicks its link, then GA4 receives select_promotion with the same parameters and no cta_click.
Given the footer, when a reader opens "Published by Anthus AI Solutions" or "Built with Papyrus", then GA4 receives cta_click with cta_location footer.
